exposure: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) performed before delivery
cohort: 50 consecutive patients with placental implant anomalies at 35-36 weeks of pregnancy were recruited for the study.
finding: UAE before delivery appeared to reduce bleeding during cesarean sections in patients with placental implant anomalies, with a minimal radiation dose to the fetus.
mod_finding: UAE before delivery appeared to reduce bleeding during cesarean sections.
